quotes.quote:
In general, our task as investment managers is to take
advantage of fluctuations in stock prices by
purchasing securities at prices that we believe are
significantly below our estimate of intrinsic value,
and generally selling securities as their market price
approaches our estimate of intrinsic value unless
there is a reason to continue to hold the security.

We believe our investment approach cannot be tested
fairly on a quarter-by-quarter basis but should be
measured in terms of total return over a long period
of time.
